Nov 3, 2026

Drawofawakening
This game is a mix of mirrors edge with a dash of bioshock and a hint of firewatch. Its atmosphere and story telling are top notch with live action cutscenes that really bring the 90s nostalgia, the voice acting and music really set the scene and the atmosphere and tension keep you hooked. The parkour is smooth and responsive with great platforming that would make a Mario brother jealous , once I started I couldn’t put it down the story kept me gripped and the gameplay keeped me entertained ,this studios first outing is a brilliant one. Would highly recommend this awesome title to any dino loving gamer.
PC Report
Nov 2, 2026
10
Math72
A really great experience and a pleasant surprise. For a debut game from an indie studio, it lives up to its promise. There are a few bugs, but that’s to be expected when a game is first released. I really liked the design of the various creatures; the environments are varied and easy to navigate. I was worried it might be too dark despite the lamp, but in the end, that wasn’t the case at all. I just found the parkour and character physics a bit tricky at first. After the first hour, I didn’t even think about it anymore. I highly recommend it; you can tell it’s been made with passion !
PC Report
Oct 27, 2026
80
Noisy Pixel
Terrible Lizards is an impressive horror-platforming debut that blends fluid Titanfall 2-style parkour with tense dinosaur chases, memorable set pieces, and strong atmosphere. Its story and characters never quite reach the same heights, but the six-to-eight-hour adventure delivers plenty of adrenaline for speedrunners and explorers alike.
